description: What the router does with the routes of a peer's family or of a network: terms in order, the first that matches a route deciding, then a default.

default.description: What the router does with a route no term matches.

terms.description: Terms in order: the first whose match holds for a route decides.

asPath.description: Regular expression the route's AS path matches, with `_` for the start, the end or a space between two ASes; null matches every path.

communityList.description: CommunityList one of whose communities the route carries; null matches every route.

prefixList.description: PrefixList the route's prefix matches; null matches every prefix.

action.description: Whether the router takes a route the term matches.

addCommunities.description: Communities added to the route: standard communities `<AS>:<value>` of 16-bit numbers, or large ones `<AS>:<value>:<value>` of 32-bit numbers.

localPref.description: Local preference the route gets; null keeps it.

med.description: Multi-exit discriminator the route gets; null keeps it.

prepend.description: How often the router puts its own AS number in front of the route's AS path; null puts none.

x-chalkos-rules.description: A term's lists are PrefixList and CommunityList documents.
x-chalkos-rules.message: a term names a PrefixList or a CommunityList that the config does not hold
x-chalkos-rules.rule: cel.bind(lists, (("router.chalkos.dev/v1alpha1" in config && "PrefixList" in config["router.chalkos.dev/v1alpha1"]) ? config["router.chalkos.dev/v1alpha1"].PrefixList : {}), cel.bind(clists, (("router.chalkos.dev/v1alpha1" in config && "CommunityList" in config["router.chalkos.dev/v1alpha1"]) ? config["router.chalkos.dev/v1alpha1"].CommunityList : {}), self.all(t, (t.match.prefixList == null || t.match.prefixList in lists) && (t.match.communityList == null || t.match.communityList in clists))))

x-chalkos-rules.description: A RoutingPolicy's PrefixLists are of one family.
x-chalkos-rules.message: the terms match PrefixLists of both families; a policy serves the routes of one family, so give each family a policy of its own
x-chalkos-rules.rule: cel.bind(lists, (("router.chalkos.dev/v1alpha1" in config && "PrefixList" in config["router.chalkos.dev/v1alpha1"]) ? config["router.chalkos.dev/v1alpha1"].PrefixList : {}), cel.bind(families, self.filter(t, t.match.prefixList != null && t.match.prefixList in lists).map(t, lists[t.match.prefixList].spec.family), families.all(f, f == families[0])))

x-chalkos-rules.description: A term that rejects sets nothing.
x-chalkos-rules.message: a term that rejects routes sets local preference, MED, communities or a prepend, which no route it rejects keeps; drop them or accept
x-chalkos-rules.rule: self.all(t, t["then"].action == "accept" || t["then"].localPref == null && t["then"].med == null && size(t["then"].addCommunities) == 0 && size(t["then"].removeCommunities) == 0 && t["then"].prepend == null)
